context.transcript:
So-Jin, I saw that you're volunteering for the financial
education event at the community center. I signed up
too, but I don't know what to expect. Do you know what
it'll be like?
Yes, I participate every year. Financial planners from
around town sign up for four hours of work. We have
short meetings with members of the community to talk
with them about investments, money management,
things like that.
Oh, that sounds great. I have a commitment in the
afternoon, but I signed up for a morning session. I bet
more people come before lunch anyway.
context.transcript_translation:
素珍，我看到你报名为社区中心的金融教育活动做志愿者了。我也报名了，不过不知道活动具体是什么样。你知道吗？
知道，我每年都参加。城里的理财规划师会报名提供四小时的志愿服务。我们会和社区居民进行简短会谈，跟他们讨论投资、资金管理之类的话题。
哦，听起来很棒。我下午有事，不过报名参加了上午的场次。我想午饭前来的人应该也会更多。
